headline: Flash floods can strike without warning — this new technology could change that
summary: New technology aims to provide earlier flash flood warnings. It combines satellite data and machine learning. This could prevent unawares like Laura Lin's home flooding.

headline: Waymo says Singapore will be its next international robotaxi city
summary: Waymo plans to launch a robotaxi service in Singapore by 2028. Vehicles will arrive soon for mapping and testing with safety drivers. This marks another step in Alphabet's overseas expansion.

headline: The AI Superintelligence Slowdown
summary: Tech leaders are rethinking 'move fast and break things' for AI development. Concerns over rogue AI and safety have prompted a slowdown. Leading US AI companies are advocating for more cautious development.

headline: Claude Code relaunches Projects to manage multiple AI agents in the cloud
summary: Claude Code's revamped Projects feature allows managing multiple AI agents. Agents share memory, goals, and files within a single project. A 'coordinator' directs parallel tasks across different 'threads.'

headline: Resident Evil (2026) 4K Steelbook Is Up for Preorder
summary: The new Resident Evil movie is now available for 4K steelbook preorder. This edition includes a Blu-ray and digital copy. Despite its recent theatrical release, it's already a collector's item.

headline: Control Resonant is Almost a Picture Perfect PC Port
summary: Control Resonant is praised as a nearly perfect PC port. It features gorgeous visuals and stellar performance. The game runs well on almost all tested PCs.

headline: Control Resonant Review
summary: Control Resonant is Remedy's sequel to 2019's Control. It shifts to open-world action combat with a character-focused story. The game retains its unique paranatural elements.

headline: Final Fantasy 7 Revelation: Second-Take Preview
summary: Final Fantasy VII Revelation offers immense freedom, expanding on previous titles. Players can explore vast open-world maps and revisit classic areas. The preview raises questions about managing potential 'bloat' from Rebirth.

headline: Flight chaos caused by software defect in space of a millisecond, report says
summary: A software defect caused widespread flight chaos. The flaw led to over 2,000 cancellations. Hundreds of thousands of passengers were affected.

headline: MI5 accepts it gave evidence based on lies in neo-Nazi spy case
summary: MI5 has admitted to presenting false evidence in court. This concerned a case involving a violent neo-Nazi informant. It's the first time MI5 confirmed the BBC's prior revelations.

headline: Russian hybrid attacks against Europe intensifying, says Macron
summary: President Macron states Russian hybrid attacks on Europe are escalating. He has ordered protection for critical infrastructure. Defence industry sites are also a priority for security measures.

headline: Women told breasts removed needlessly as NHS trust finds more than 300 suffered harm
summary: An NHS trust discovered over 300 women underwent needless breast removals. The new chief executive issued an unreserved apology. He labeled the incidents as 'utterly unacceptable.'
